text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1151, Blue Crab Door Knocker in Polished Brass with Brown Patina

The 4-1/2 Inch Brass and Brown Crab Door Knocker is made by Michael Healy Designs and shows the attention to detail and craftsmanship that make his unique front door knockers a lasting first impression. The Blue Crab Door Knocker is 4.5 inches tall and has 7/8 inch mounting centers. This surface mounted door knocker comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware. It is made out of sandcast brass and is finished in Polished Brass with Brown Patina.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Polished Brass and Brown Patina Nickel Silver Oiled Bronze

Features and Specifications of the Blue Crab Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass and Brown Patina
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 5-1/4"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 7/8"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-3/4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
